meta.name: bioservices
meta.description: Unified Python interface to 40+ bioinformatics services. Use when querying multiple databases (UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL, Reactome) in a single workflow with consistent API. Best for cross-database analysis, ID mapping across services. For quick single-database lookups use gget; for sequence/file manipulation use biopython.

copy.tagline: 用一个 Python 接口同时查询多个生物数据库,把跨库结果整合到一起
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常在多个生物数据库之间来回查数据、手动对齐编号
copy.tagline_en: Query many biological databases through one Python interface and combine the results
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you hop between many biology databases and hand-match identifiers

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能用 Python 通过统一接口查询约 40 个生物信息学数据库（UniProt、KEGG、ChEMBL 等），做跨库检索、ID 转换、BLAST 比对和通路分析，并写出可运行的脚本。
howto.when: 当你要在同一个流程里查询多个数据库、跨库转换 ID 或跑 BLAST 时接管；单库快速查询和序列、文件操作另有工具可做。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can query about 40 bioinformatics databases (UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL, etc.) through one Python interface, doing cross-database searches, ID mapping, BLAST runs and pathway analysis, and writing runnable scripts.
howto.when_en: Use it when one workflow queries several databases, maps IDs across them, or runs BLAST; quick single-database lookups and sequence/file work have other tools.
